description.value: Seaport City Seafood Restaurant is a contemporary Chinese fine dining destination on Cambie Street in Vancouver, specializing in premium seafood dishes made with carefully hand-picked fresh ingredients. The bilingual (English and Chinese) establishment aims to deliver a multisensory dining experience that blends the soul of traditional Chinese seafood cuisine with a modern, upscale atmosphere.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at seaportcityrestaurant.com is active and confirms the business name and address (2425 Cambie Street, Vancouver V5Z 4M5), and provides a phone number (604-222-7288) that is absent from the OSM record. The active website with a 2026 copyright date and functioning reservation and ordering systems confirms the restaurant is currently open.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number listed; phone 604-222-7288 sourced from website only. OSM address lacked postal code; website supplies V5Z 4M5.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant with a functioning website, online ordering, and reservation system — a useful dining stop for touring cyclists on Cambie Street.
